cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 66% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.76% · WTI -1.08% · Brent -4.58% · NatGas +15.11%. 66% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +4.08%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.08%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -0.30%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.89%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.89%, GEV +4.58%, TLN +4.22%, PWR +4.19%, VRT +3.20%. Laggards: EQT -4.13%, ENPH -3.92%, SEDG -3.66%, EOSE -2.60%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
